Micron::workday::JR113501.title: HIG Product Engineer - Media Health
Micron::workday::JR113501.raw_text: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. As a Product Development Engineer in the Media Health team, you will connect various engineering groups and specialties. You will combine diverse expertise to develop new and improved test strategies, features, and technologies. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to work with the newest technology, helping to build the future of memory and storage solutions. You will have or develop guide capability with Probe, and/or ATE test code and testing techniques used to validate and ensure device performance. You will assist in debugging code and aiding other specialists in the characterization of applicable HBM devices. In this role, your additional responsibilities include an in-depth understanding of general device functionality specific to HBM products as well as schematics and signal integrity. Responsibilities: Collaborate with Design Engineering (DE) to conduct pre-silicon simulations to validate test strategies and circuits for Test. Provide feedback to DE, Test Engineering (TE), and others in Product Engineering (PE). Support pre-silicon checklist tasks and collaborate with TE to identify vital tester resources. Collaborate with TE and PE to adjust test programs for particular product needs to guarantee that silicon performance aligns with expectations. Support TE by aiding in test program debug, data analysis, and test development using AI assistants. Assist fabrication sites and process integration with test creation to improve effective process feedback. Debug and identify root causes for failures using test and experimental data, and electrical and physical analysis results. Use these results to modify existing testing strategies to improve product quality and enhance yield. Supervise yields to ensure they are meeting projections and expeditiously investigate root causes when they are not. Provide technical training and expertise, including on-the-job training for new engineers, assisting with data interpretation, acting as a product-specific point of contact, and attending technical seminars. Support the local team by building AI-powered tools crafted to advance processes and develop innovative, optimized test strategies and features. Minimum Qualifications: Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field and proven experience in a similar product engineering role. Education or experience in building Digital circuits, ASIC testing using scan tools, Python, and C programming. Custom BIST APG programming for memory testing. Experience with Linux operating system. Engage in hands-on bench testing of product to uncover issues and formulate tests. Preferred Qualifications: High volume production data extraction and analysis using JMP and/or python. Provide assistance to fabrication sites and process integration through the creation of tests aimed at improving effective process feedback. Hands on bench testing of engineering hardware and Coordinated Circuits. Experience in Circuit simulations using spice and Verilog. Knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication process. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . Job Title: Product Security Engineer, Infrastructure Job Category: Technology / Security Location: San Francisco, CA or Bellevue, WA The Experience Join our Infrastructure Product Security Assurance team as a Product Security Engineer, where you play a pivotal role in fortifying the bedrock of Salesforce's entire product ecosystem. In this highly impactful position, you leverage deep technical expertise to provide strategic security guidance and leadership to engineering teams responsible for our foundational services, including technical controls, infrastructure databases, and monitoring tools across public cloud platforms. As a trusted security engineer, you serve as the primary point of contact for engineering partners and leadership, cultivating strong relationships and delivering critical security recommendations. Your contributions directly shape and enhance the security posture of our core infrastructure platforms, ensuring the resilience and integrity of Salesforce's offerings. Our team specializes in providing deep architectural and infrastructure security expertise across a diverse range of technologies, both on-premises and in public cloud environments, including web applications, distributed systems, and virtualized infrastructures. You champion secure software development lifecycle (SSDL) best practices, empowering engineering teams to build secure products from the ground up. What You'll Actually Be Doing Provide expert security advisory for large-scale cloud initiatives, offering strategic guidance to engineering teams on complex enterprise architectures across the application and infrastructure stack. Drive proactive security through architecture and threat modeling, partnering with engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities and develop risk mitigation plans throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Influence secure design and implementation by collaborating with product teams to recommend design solutions that balance functional goals with security requirements. Align security priorities with business risk by working with Product Business Information Security Officers (BISOs) to curate and prioritize risk-based security initiatives, and by analyzing risk signals and emerging threats to shape security roadmaps. You're Our Person If... You have 3-5 years of experience in a security engineering, security architecture, or security assurance role. Cloud Security: You have experience securing products and infrastructure across one or more public cloud environments (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, or equivalent), with an understanding of cloud service models, shared responsibility boundaries, and identity primitives at scale. Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment: You have experience conducting structured security design reviews and threat modeling across infrastructure and application security domains, with familiarity with common vulnerability classes (Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10, Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Top 25), and can evaluate and communicate security risk to technical and non-technical audiences alike. Identity, Access, and Network Fundamentals: You understand authentication and authorization patterns including Open Authorization (OAuth) / OpenID Connect (OIDC), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), service-to-service authentication, and API authorization models, as well as TCP/IP, Transport Layer Security (TLS), network segmentation, and key management, certificate lifecycles, secrets handling, and encryption standards. You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams toward secure outcomes without relying on direct organizational authority. Even Better If... You can reason through abuse cases and attack paths, not just defensive recommendations, with some familiarity with penetration testing methodologies or offensive security techniques. You have experience participating in or driving improvements to a secure development lifecycle, security review process, or security advisory program within an engineering organization. You can work with structured data, identify patterns across a broad service portfolio, and propose mitigations that address root causes rather than individual findings. You can read and reason about code in one or more languages common in cloud-native engineering environments — particularly Java, Go, or Python — and have hands-on familiarity with container orchestration and workload security (Kubernetes, Docker, service mesh such as Istio), secrets/key management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) tooling, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and vulnerability scanning tools, or static analysis (SAST) and infrastructure-as-code security scanning. We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to build and operate the automation that keeps third-party and open-source dependencies across a large service fleet patched, auditable, and shipped on time. You will own feature-level work on the pipelines that discover vulnerable packages, decide what to upgrade, open fix PRs across many repositories, and track those fixes through to deployed production artifacts. This role is pitched at engineers who are strong in pipeline and automation work and are ready to grow into software supply chain security as the problem domain — not at supply chain specialists who code on the side. We will teach you the standards (CVE, CVSS, SBOM, SLSA, Sigstore) if you bring the engineering fundamentals. Responsibilities: Pipeline Development & Operations Contribute to data pipelines that ingest vulnerability data, dependency manifests, SBOM artifacts, and deployment metadata into a queryable analytics store. Build and maintain batch and streaming jobs with idempotent steps, retries, and clear failure modes. Operate what you ship: on-call for the pipelines you own, debug production failures, and reduce toil through automation. Repository-wide Automation Build scripts and small services that interact with many repositories at once — opening PRs, parsing diffs, reading CI feedback, and reconciling the results back into a central store. Author and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage so remediation PRs can be reviewed and merged with confidence. Resolve attribution issues at the source rather than patching symptoms downstream. Collaboration & Communication Partner with service owners to land dependency upgrades, triage breakage, and raise the quality of generated fix PRs. Translate noisy scanner output into prioritized, actionable work for engineering teams. Write clear design docs, runbooks, and PR descriptions; keep documentation current when behavior changes. Quality & Growth Write Python and Java code that matches the conventions of the existing codebase and holds up under review. Add regression tests for every bug you fix; treat failing tests as signal rather than noise. Learn the supply chain domain on the job — vulnerability lifecycle, dependency resolution, artifact provenance — and bring that knowledge back into the pipelines you build. Required Skills / Experience Industry Experience : 3+ years in software engineering with strong proficiency in Python and Java, and reading-fluency in at least two of Node.js, Go, and Ruby. Pipeline Engineering : Hands-on experience contributing to data pipelines — batch or streaming — including writing idempotent steps and reasoning about retries. CI/CD : Direct experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage. Repo-wide Automation : Comfort writing scripts or small services that interact with many repositories — opening PRs, parsing diffs, handling CI feedback. Workflow Orchestration and Query Engines : Experience with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal) and a lakehouse / columnar query engine (Trino, Presto, Spark, Snowflake, BigQuery, Athena, Databricks, or Iceberg). SQL : Non-trivial joins, window functions, CTEs. Individual Impact : End-to-end ownership at the feature level — design, implementation, deployment, and the maintenance work that follows. Educational Background : B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Preferred / Bonus Skills Supply Chain Security Standards : Working familiarity with CVE, CVSS v3, EPSS, KEV (CISA), and SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX) Scanner & Remediation Tooling : Direct experience with at least two of Snyk, Trivy, Grype, Dependabot, Renovate, Semgrep SCA, OSV-Scanner, or Dependency-Track. Reachability Analysis : Exposure to reachability tooling (e.g., Semgrep) to prioritize fixes by exploitability rather than raw CVE count. GitHub-at-Scale Automation : Experience driving changes across many repositories through GitHub Actions, Dependabot configuration, or custom bots. Container Supply Chain : Working knowledge of layer-based image scanning and base-image lifecycle management. Cloud Infrastructure : Working experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and container-based deployment. CrowdStrike::workday::R30742.raw_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About The Role: CrowdStrike's Falcon sensor runs on millions of endpoints globally, protecting more than half of the Fortune 500 companies. It's a high-performance, lightweight agent that detects and prevents sophisticated threats in real-time. It's one of the most widely deployed security platforms in the world, running across every major OS and architecture. Every Falcon sensor release ships to millions of endpoints, so knowing a release is healthy — and being able to prove it — is a high-stakes problem. We're looking for a Software Engineer to design and build the systems, metrics, and dashboards that give engineers and leadership one clear, trusted picture of sensor and release health. You'll join a small team of 4 engineers (remote and hybrid) focused on the metrics, dashboards, and developer tooling that give visibility into the overall health of our build system — tools that sensor engineers and leadership rely on every day. You'll start in our repo-health rotation to see firsthand where sensor teams get stuck — and continue building the automation that replaces that manual process with AI-assisted signals, so attention goes to the highest-priority work. This role sits at the intersection of developer tooling, metrics, and release quality. You'll work primarily in Python and Django on the backend, and React and CSS on the front end, turning raw signal into clear, actionable insight. We're also building out agentic workflows with Claude Code — you'll help create the skills and commands that both our automated systems and the sensor engineering team use day to day, solving problems like: How do we know a sensor repo is unhealthy before it becomes a crisis? How do we give every stakeholder a single source of truth on release quality? How do we quantify the health of the tools and processes our team owns? This role is a hybrid role with an expectation of at least 2x days in office each week, working out of one of the posted locations. What You'll Do: Design and build our sensor quality dashboard from the ground up, giving engineers and leadership full visibility into the health of active sensor releases across multiple metrics Own the process of defining new signals and metrics for repo and release health, and instrument the systems needed to capture them Spend time in our repo-health rotation, partnering with sensor teams to see firsthand where engineers get stuck — then build the tooling that fixes it Build and maintain metrics and visibility across all tooling and processes owned by our team Build and extend Claude Code skills, commands, and agentic workflows used by both our automated systems and the sensor engineering team Drive improvements by identifying gaps in visibility, prototyping solutions, and shipping dashboards and tooling that measurably improve how our team and stakeholders understand sensor health Work with our data stack — LogScale, PostgreSQL, and Valkey — to collect, process, and surface sensor health metrics reliably What You'll Need: 3+ years building production systems with a focus on developer tooling, metrics, or observability/monitoring Strong Python experience (we build on Django) Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Experience with AI-assisted development workflows (we use Claude Code and are building out agentic workflows day to day) Bonus Points: Cloud experience, applied to collecting and surfacing sensor health metrics Front-end (UI) experience (React, CSS) building robust, production-grade dashboards Experience with GitLab CI/CD A focus on AI fluency and staying current with AI-assisted tooling #LI-JC1 Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Micron::workday::JR116566.raw_text: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Key Responsibilities: Work closely with multiple teams across IT, Information Security, Technology, and business functions to drive impactful change. Design, develop, integrate, and support scalable enterprise solutions across Kinaxis, SAP, Blue Yonder (BY), and related enterprise planning applications . Analyze and troubleshoot complex system and integration issues across Kinaxis, SAP, and BY , leveraging Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and AI-Enabled tools where applicable to accelerate problem solving and improve productivity. Understand end-to-end business processes, system integrations, and data flows across enterprise planning platforms, and assess upstream and downstream impacts of application and software changes. Leverage data and AI Assisted analysis to support impact assessment, root-cause analysis, solution design, testing, and continuous improvement. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams on end-to-end integration testing, system validation, and performance analysis; resolve issues, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and drive initiatives through completion. Leverage AI Assistants and Large Language Models (LLMs) , where appropriate, to support software development, analysis, automation, testing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation while maintaining appropriate human review and accountability. Identify opportunities for AI-Enabled and Agentic AI solutions , automation, and process improvements across enterprise planning and supply chain applications. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. Micron::workday::JR116017.raw_text: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Our Opportunity Summary: At Micron, we build memory and storage solutions that power the technologies changing how the world works, learns, and connects. We're looking for passionate people to join us and help grow and innovate in the semiconductor industry. As a Process Control Systems Engineer, you'll develop, deploy, and sustain Run-to-Run (R2R) and Fault Detection and Classification (FDC) strategies. These strategies protect process stability, yield, and quality across wafer fabrication. You'll work with manufacturing, engineering, and information systems teams on site, and with counterparts worldwide. (Disclaimer ) While you may not exhibit all of the characteristics/skills listed below today, we are highly interested in a team member who is anxious to grow in both technical breadth and depth. If you are open to learning from and being a valued member of a team of top-tier engineers, we are eager to help build on your existing foundation and expand your individual and collaborative skills in this exciting and unique opportunity. What’s Encouraged Daily: Partner with manufacturing and engineering customers to define control requirements and choose the right R2R and FDC solutions. Develop, deploy, and maintain R2R controllers and FDC strategies, including data collection, limits, and out-of-control action plans (OCAPs). Monitor controller and strategy performance, and use data analysis to improve existing control methods. Use AMAT E3 to implement strategy enhancements and bug fixes, and develop smaller R2R code modules or sub-strategies. Configure data collection and troubleshoot strategy, tool, system, and communication issues across Host, CIM, and Sigma. Investigate process variation and excursions, find root causes, and drive corrective actions. Follow worldwide business rules and best known methods (BKMs), manage changes through change management, and document all strategies and changes. Deliver R2R training, share lessons learned with global teams, and lead small teams on quality and cost-improvement projects. How To Qualify: Shown through education, internships, research, military, manufacturing, or professional experience. Bachelor's degree or advanced certification in a related technical field, OR equivalent technical military experience, OR an equivalent mix of education and relevant experience. Knowledge of process control methods, including SPC, R2R, and FDC. Experience with data analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective action in a manufacturing environment. Ability to troubleshoot software, system, and equipment communication issues. Strong communication and documentation skills, and experience working across functions. What Sets You Apart: Hands-on experience with AMAT E3 (R2R, FDC, SPC/SPACE modules). Familiarity with CIM, MES, APC, and GEM/SECS systems in high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Experience with change management, BKMs, and controlled documentation in a global, multi-site environment. Experience leading small technical teams or projects, and delivering training to end users. Experience and/or interest in developing Agentic AI workflows into current or future processes. Our team vision is a continuing desire to develop your skills working in an inclusive, diverse environment of multicultural Teams across worldwide geographies! CrowdStrike::workday::R29874.raw_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About The Role: CrowdStrike Falcon is a two-component security product. One component is the "Sensor" — a lightweight agent installed on endpoint systems that observes system activity, recognizes malicious behavior, provides on-box prevention capability, and sends telemetry to the Falcon cloud. The cloud component aggregates Sensor telemetry across each customer's network, correlates malicious behavior across machines, and presents security teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments. The Falcon Sensor runs on tens of millions of endpoints worldwide, across Windows, macOS and Linux, in both user mode and kernel mode. Engineering software at that depth and that scale is among the hardest problems in the industry, and CrowdStrike holds the Sensor to an exceptionally high standard of quality, performance and engineering rigor. Sustaining that standard requires a team with true mastery of what software does at runtime, at the lowest levels of the stack. That team is Sensor Performance and Reliability — CrowdStrike's team of debug engineers. Deep runtime analysis is our craft: postmortem memory dump analysis, disassembly and reverse engineering, and source-level analysis, used to explain with precision and evidence how low-level code behaves on real systems. It is one of the most technically demanding specialties in systems engineering, and very few organizations invest in it as a discipline in its own right. We do, because at our scale the answer to "what exactly happened, and why?" has to be exact rather than approximate. Our mandate goes further than answering that question well. We're chartered to turn what we learn from deep analysis into durable engineering improvements — strengthening diagnostics, tooling, validation coverage and development practices so that lessons generalize far beyond the investigation that produced them, and so that the next analysis is faster than the last. Our work makes the product stronger, and it raises the engineering capability of every team we work with. We are hiring an entry-level engineer to join us in that mission. We do not expect you to arrive with deep Windows internals, assembly, or reverse engineering experience. Those are skills we will teach you, and you will learn them from engineers who operate at the top of this field. What we are looking for is a strong programmer with excellent problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity about how computers actually work underneath the abstractions — someone who is drawn to a hard, ambiguous problem rather than put off by it. If you are the kind of person who cannot leave a mystery alone until you understand it completely, this is an unusually good place to build a career. Location: This is a hybrid role based out of one of the posted locations: Redmond, WA or Sunnyvale, CA , with a combination of in-office and remote work. What You'll Do: Analyze the runtime behavior of complex low-level software across user mode and kernel mode on Windows, primarily through postmortem memory dump analysis in WinDbg. Work from raw memory, register state and disassembly to a precise, evidence-backed account of what executing code did and why — and hold yourself to a high evidentiary bar in reaching it. Correlate your analysis with source code, applying reverse engineering and disassembly techniques where symbols, source or context are incomplete. Drive investigations to accurate, well-reasoned conclusions rather than plausible-sounding ones, and communicate confidence and uncertainty honestly. Partner with Sensor development teams to translate your findings into concrete, well-designed engineering improvements. Generalize from individual investigations: recognize patterns, and champion improvements to tooling, diagnostics, automated validation and engineering practice that raise the reliability bar broadly rather than locally. Build and improve the tooling, automation and analysis techniques that make deep runtime analysis faster, more repeatable and more accessible — for our team and for Sensor engineers across the company. Write clearly and precisely for engineering, quality and leadership audiences. A first-rate technical analysis is only as valuable as its reader's ability to act on it. Collaborate with engineering teams across multiple locations and timezones, including Sensor platform, detection and OS-specialist teams. What You'll Need: BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Solid working knowledge of C and C++, and the ability to read and reason about code you did not write. Good foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, and comfort working with incomplete information — much of this work involves reconstructing runtime behavior from partial evidence. Genuine curiosity about systems fundamentals: operating system internals, computer architecture, memory management, concurrency, compilers and assembly. You should want to learn these deeply. Persistence and intellectual honesty: the willingness to keep digging until you actually know the answer, and to say clearly when you don't yet. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to take ownership of your work and follow it through to resolution. Ability to communicate, collaborate, and work effectively in a globally distributed team. Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points: Any exposure to debugging tools and techniques — WinDbg, GDB, LLDB, or similar — including as a hobby, in coursework, or in CTFs. Coursework, internships, or personal projects involving operating system internals, kernel or driver development, systems programming, or computer architecture. Familiarity with x86-64 or ARM64 assembly and the ability to read disassembly. Exposure to reverse engineering, malware analysis, or vulnerability research. Experience with Windows internals specifically (processes, threads, virtual memory, synchronization, the Windows kernel and driver model). Scripting experience, particularly Python, for automation and analysis tooling. Interest in or experience with the security landscape. #LI-CW1 Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Resolve implementation issues, coordinate engineering changes, and ensure the solution is practical, scalable, and ready for production use. Preserve test effectiveness throughout the lifecycle. Establish the preventive-maintenance, calibration, out-of-tolerance response, configuration control, data retention, and performance-monitoring requirements necessary to keep deployed test systems reliable and effective. Measure outcomes, not activity. Monitor detection effectiveness, test-system performance, false failures, escapes, NCs, DMRs, and other relevant quality and operational indicators. Use the results to verify effectiveness and identify the next improvement opportunity. Prevent recurrence at the source. Apply lessons from escapes to improve supplier test mandates, Functional Requirements Documents, FMEA/FMECA, Design for Testability, and applicable product-lifecycle deliverables so that prevention becomes part of how future products are developed. Lead across organizational boundaries. Drive multiple complex initiatives across suppliers, factories, Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Supplier Engineering, NPI Quality, Product Quality & Reliability, and business-unit teams. Micron::workday::JR116740.title: Fab Equipment Engineer - SWE
Micron::workday::JR116740.raw_text: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. As an Equipment Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment by solving complex technical challenges, owning end-to-end equipment performances, and partnering across manufacturing, process engineering, maintenance, and supplier teams. As part of Micron’s AI-enabled ecosystem, Fab Equipment Engineers use AI-supported data, equipment health insights, and advanced analytics to improve tool performance, reliability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement across semiconductor manufacturing. RESPONSIBILITIES Own equipment performance and reliability by identifying issues, driving corrective actions, and lifecycle improvement strategies Diagnose technical issues by applying structured problem-solving and enabling rapid tool recovery to prevent emerging issues Drive equipment upgrade/modification projects, implement hardware solutions and partner with vendors to resolve issues Partner and collaborate across functions (Process, Manufacturing, Facilities, Quality, Maintenance teams) to resolve issues Communicate findings and recommendations to team members Build and maintain SOPs, solving guides, and promote information exchange Ensure compliance with safety, quality and manufacturing standards Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or advanced certification in a related technical field, equivalent technical military experience, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Experience may be demonstrated through education, internships, research, military service, manufacturing, or professional experience. Demonstrated experience with technical solving, root cause analysis, equipment or system diagnostics, and analyzing and interpreting data . Demonstrated experience with SPC principles and Continuous Improvement in an engineering, research, manufacturing, military, or comparable technical environment. Demonstrated experience working with mechanical, electrical, automation, or manufacturing systems , along with the ability to produce user documentation and communicate effectively with multi-functional collaborators. Willing and able to work 12-hour shifts, including nights and weekends in a 24/7 fab environment; stand and walk for full shifts on uneven or tight floors; wear required PPE and cleanroom garments; bend, kneel, and climb to access equipment; and lift up to 40 pounds . Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering , or a related technical field. Experience or exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or high-volume manufacturing . Experience or exposure to equipment maintenance and reliability, robotics and automation, vacuum systems, or industrial control systems . Experience or exposure to SPC, FDC, MES, or other manufacturing data and control systems . Experience or exposure to process improvement, equipment qualification, or equipment validation . The Offensive Security AI Engineer will plan and implement adversary-informed security testing across Micron's technology environment. The successful candidate will balance deep technical execution with sound judgment, responsible use of AI, clear documentation, and effective communication with both technical and non-technical audiences. Responsibilities : Plan, implement, lead, and report on internal and external penetration tests, red team operations, purple team exercises, and targeted security assessments. Evaluate proposed architecture and design decisions to identify attack paths, trust-boundary weaknesses, insecure assumptions, and gaps in secure design principles. Collaborate with multi-functional partners to explain findings, prioritize remediation, implement corrective actions, and translate technical risk into business impact. Minimum Qualifications : Significant experience participating in and leading offensive security operations, including penetration testing or red team engagements. Practical experience testing multiple technology domains, such as applications, APIs, cloud, identity, infrastructure, endpoints, mobile, wireless, or security controls. Working knowledge of AI and large language model security concepts, common attack surfaces, and the risks introduced by models, data, agents, tools, and integrations. Strong written, presentation, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain highly technical issues to non-technical audiences. Experience building reusable automation, security testing frameworks, agentic workflows, or integrations that support offensive security operations. Experience assessing AI-enabled applications or platforms using adversarial testing techniques. Experience working in complex enterprise, cloud, manufacturing, product security, or globally distributed environments. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness. Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build. You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff. This is a hands-on data and software engineering role . You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it. What You'll Do Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls. Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric). Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes. Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data. Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents. Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents. Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems. Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies. Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error. Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead. Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value. Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations. Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support. You're Our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer If... You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation , including a production data solution you can explain in detail. You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations. You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform. You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks. You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed. You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing , and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access. You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance. You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication. You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases . You diagnose technical problems methodically , use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result. You can implement against a documented architecture , explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner. You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments . You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects. You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Intel::workday::JR0288539.raw_text: Job Details: Job Description: Drive the Automated Circulatory Engine of Intel Foundry At Intel Foundry Technology & Manufacturing, we design, build, and scale the physical and digital infrastructure that powers the future of computing. Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) serve as the circulatory system of Intel’s high-volume manufacturing facilities, enabling continuous 24x7 wafer transport and reticle delivery across our Gordon Moore Park at Ronler Acres and Aloha campuses. We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Systems Software Development Engineer to take ownership of real-time cleanroom automation architectures, high-availability control software, and data-driven factory throughput. Operating at the convergence of distributed software systems, factory physics, and advanced cleanroom operations, you will directly influence wafer cycle times, tool availability, and operational yield for next-generation process nodes. What You Will Do AMHS Equipment Ownership: Serve as the technical expert responsible for ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of the AMHS within the manufacturing environment. Maintain system uptime targets based on organizational goals, through proactive monitoring, preventive maintenance execution, and rapid response to Major Impacts (MI), while simultaneously driving innovation through the evaluation and implementation of new technologies. Flexibility to participate in an operational on-call rotation to support 24x7 manufacturing escalations. Architect & Deliver Factory Automation Software Integration: Design, integrate, and deploy robust end-to-end software solutions for 300mm wafer transport, reticle management, and automated stocker systems across high-volume cleanroom environments Optimize Distributed Control Systems: Debug, tune, and sustain multi-tier automation platforms—spanning low-level firmware, OS configurations, database interfaces, and real-time scheduling algorithms—to maximize tool availability and eliminate dispatch bottlenecks. Lead New Product Introductions (NPI): Partner cross-functionally with IT Platforms, Networks, Middleware, and Module Equipment Engineering to qualify and integrate new automation capabilities with zero operational disruption to high-volume manufacturing line balance. Own Complex Escalations & Root Cause Analysis: Function as the module technical authority for system excursions; drive structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement robust permanent corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). Champion Fab Data Intelligence: Develop performant SQL queries, Python automation routines, and PowerBI dashboards to monitor fleet health, analyze telemetry logs, and proactively eliminate systemic failures before they manifest as tool downtime. Continuous Improvement: Strive to improve corrective and preventive maintenance overload from maintenance by continually looking for opportunities to improve maintenance through innovative ideas and enhancements. All improvements need to be driven through the DPO and DPG to ensure all sites benefit through these CIPs. Project Management: Complete equipment qualification in accordance with the appropriate qual specifications, contribute to global knowledge revisions based on ongoing learning and lessons learned during system qualifications. Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment (including walking long fab distances and working at heights around automated track superstructures). Execute Global Standards: Collaborate with Intel’s worldwide AMHS engineering network to maintain alignment with Copy Exactly! (CE!) protocols and industry SEMI standards. Why Join Intel Foundry? Direct Impact at Global Scale: Your code directly governs real-time wafer movement and operational KPIs across one of the most sophisticated semiconductor manufacturing ecosystems on earth. World-Class Automation Ecosystem: Direct, hands-on access to multi-million-dollar automated storage, overhead transport (OHT), and robotics infrastructure engineered alongside premier global equipment partners. Intel::workday::JR0288200.raw_text: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact As a GPU Software Development Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing software solutions that enable Intel's GPUs, ranging from firmware and device drivers to APIs and application layers. You will work on cutting-edge kernel-level features that drive functionality, power management, and performance optimization for integrated and discrete graphics products. Your contributions will directly shape immersive visual experiences for millions of users, ensuring Intel's leadership in graphics technologies. Business Group We are the Windows Kernel Mode Driver Team within Intel's Client Graphics IP group of DCG. Our primary objective is the development and deployment of robust and performant Windows kernel GPU drivers. These drivers are instrumental in unleashing the full potential of Intel's integrated and discrete GPU hardware for user-space clients, games, and applications. Our focus lies in managing critical low-level functions, including device activation, reset and power state transitions, workload submission, power conservation, and scheduling, as well as collaboration with System-on-Chip (SOC) Intellectual Properties (IPs). With this charter, we conceive, create, and verify software solutions that serve as the link between user-space applications and the underlying GPU and SOC. If you thrive in an environment that involves working on system-level software, with regular exposure to diverse domains such as graphics rendering, firmware, SOC, and power management, then a role on our Kernel Mode Driver Team is where you should be. Key Responsibilities: Develop, validate, and optimize GPU kernel-mode drivers for Windows operating systems. Collaborate on implementing low-level features, including device activation, power management, and workload scheduling for integrated and discrete GPUs. Design and debug firmware and software features related to GPU hardware and accompanying System-on-Chip (SOC) components. Analyze telemetry and resolve complex issues across layers of driver stacks, domains, and IP integration. Contribute to the creation of test frameworks, workload automation, and validation methodologies to ensure high-quality code delivery. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field. 3+ years of relevant industry experience, in two or more of the experience below: Python for automation/data analysis and C/C++ for firmware and software development. Developing kernel-mode device drivers for Windows OS, including knowledge of WDDM and kernel-level programming. GPU (Graphic Processing unit) hardware, graphic drivers, and low-level GPU programming. Intel::workday::JR0287695.raw_text: Job Details: Job Description: About the Role Join Intel's graphics software team and help deliver high-quality GPU experiences in AI domain. As a GPU Software Engineer, you will develop, validate, debug, and optimize graphics software and GPU driver solutions across Intel platforms. You will work at the intersection of software and hardware, partnering with engineering teams to bring new graphics capabilities to market and solve complex system-level issues. This is an opportunity to develop hands-on expertise across GPU architecture, graphics drivers, validation, debugging, performance, compute, and AI workloads. What You’ll Do Key responsibilities will include but not limited to: Develop and execute end-to-end validation solutions for GPU software, graphics drivers, and applications. Debug and resolve complex software, driver, and system-level issues impacting GPU functionality, quality, and performance. Triage defects, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with software and hardware engineering teams to drive issues to resolution. Develop and maintain software, automation, and debugging tools that improve validation efficiency and product quality. Analyze cross-component interactions and identify potential quality, performance, and compatibility issues. Perform validation, triage, and debugging of GPU compute drivers, runtime layers, and AI framework integration failures across software and hardware teams. Integrate latest AI features into end-to-end validation flows and analyze cross-component interactions to develop robust test scenarios. Develop and maintain automation tools, benchmarking suites, and frameworks to improve validation and debug efficiency across AI compute and runtime components. Optimize software performance, memory efficiency, and quality for emerging AI workloads, deep learning inference, and agentic applications. Enable and validate forthcoming AI hardware acceleration capabilities for Intel's GPU platforms. Collaborate on cross-OS software development and validation for GPU-accelerated AI and machine learning workloads. Behavioral traits that we are looking for: Technical curiosity: Motivated to understand how software, GPU hardware, drivers, operating systems, and applications interact. Problem-solving: Uses structured analysis and data to troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify root causes. Proactive ownership: Identifies potential issues or opportunities early, takes initiative, and follows problems through to resolution. Collaboration: Works effectively across software, hardware, validation, and architecture teams to solve cross-functional problems. Communication: Clearly communicates technical findings, risks, and recommendations to technical stakeholders. Learning agility: Quickly learns new GPU architectures, graphics technologies, tools, APIs, and development environments. Quality mindset: Demonstrates attention to detail and considers product quality, reliability, performance, and the end-user experience when making technical decisions. Adaptability: Effectively manages changing requirements and priorities in a fast-paced engineering environment Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. Your experience described above must be in the following: Software development using C, C++, or Python. Experience with AI validation workloads such as LLM inference evaluation, and agentic framework integration. Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks and runtimes such as PyTorch, OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, or TensorFlow. Experience with industry-standard APIs and frameworks such as DirectX, OpenGL, OpenCL, or Vulkan. Preferred Qualifications and Experience : Experience with validation, triage, or debugging computer graphics hardware and software. Proven expertise in optimizing GPU compute software for throughput and latency (e.g., operator fusion, KV-cache optimization, low-bit quantization like INT4/INT8/FP8). Familiarity with cross-OS profiling and debug tools such as WinDbg, GPUView, GDB, Intel VTune, emulators, or JTAG-debuggers. Experience with CI/CD practices, automated validation frameworks, and containerized cross-platform testing environments. Strong collaboration skills and passion for staying updated on emerging AI algorithms and hardware acceleration technologies. Why Join Intel? Help shape the future of GPU computing by developing and validating graphics technologies that power gaming, content creation, media, and emerging AI experiences. You'll solve challenging problems across hardware and software while working with engineers bringing next-generation Intel graphics capabilities from development to real-world products. To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Software Engineering Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. The Experience Salesforce Trust Platform, providing foundational security, availability, compliance, and resilience for the Agentic Enterprise. From the hardware-backed Root-of-Trust to application guardrails for administrators, end users, and ISVs, we make every layer of technology secure-by-default. We make it extremely hard to attack Salesforce, misconfigure Salesforce, or introduce security bugs at Salesforce. We scale our zero-trust, always available infrastructure for the most mission-critical enterprise workloads of the world. We multiply our impact with AI. We use agents and automation to achieve auto-containment and time-to-recover targets that are only possible without human-in-the-loop. What You'll Actually Be Doing Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software ,with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. Architect and maintain resilient backend services integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via external APIs, while implementing robust observability frameworks (logs, metrics, traces) to monitor long-running AI jobs. Critically evaluate code (Human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. Develop test automation and quality tooling, focusing on unit/CI test generation, test failure analysis, and flake awareness. You're Our Person If... 3+ years of professional Java development experience. A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering, using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in active development workflows. Ability to design, iterate on, and test system and user prompts that produce structured, parseable LLM outputs (JSON classification, multi-field extraction). Designing and consuming RESTful APIs alongside working knowledge of AWS (S3, STS, KMS, Lambda, DynamoDB). Experience with Bazel or Maven and a strong willingness to work in a monorepo. Experience with Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD pipelines, Docker image creation, and container operations. Office-Flex: work in-person three days per week; or 10 days per quarter for some engineering teams. Even Better If... Experience with TypeScript (Node) and/or Python service development is a strong plus. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. About Futureforce University Recruiting Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. Job Category Software Engineering Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **This role is for candidates who are able to start immediately in Q4 and Q1 (November 2026 – April 2027). Candidates must be available to begin work within this window to be considered. The Experience Want your line of code to have a significant and measurable positive impact for users, the company's bottom line, and industry? Join Salesforce and define the future of cloud computing. We deliver a scalable, high performance cloud computing platform that delights our customers, and is used by millions of people around the world each day for their business. You will be working with a group of world-class engineers to build breakthrough features that our customers will love, adopt and use while keeping our trusted platform stable and scalable. The software engineer role at Salesforce encompasses architecture, design, implementation, and testing to ensure we build products right and release them with high quality. We are looking for the best and brightest college graduates to join our team of world class, highly motivated software engineers and cloud computing experts. You will have a chance to be mentored and network with senior levels at Salesforce, and be a part of a year long graduate program with various targeted events throughout the year. From Marketing Cloud to Service Cloud, Platform to IoT, Einstein Platform, Security and everything in between we have many opportunities available across various applications and platforms. Apply now and we look forward to reaching out to you with opportunities that fit your background and interests! What You'll Actually Be Doing Architect, design, implement, test and deliver highly scalable products Master our development process, culture and code base, then improve it Work closely with a team of engineers, product managers, user experience experts and performance engineers to build new features our customers will love, adopt and use while keeping our trusted platform stable and scalable Develop test strategies, design automation frameworks, write unit/functional tests to drive up code coverage and automation metrics Analyze, design and develop test cases and implement automated test suites You're Our Person If... Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline. Must be located in North America Academic, professional or internship experience working in a professional coding setting environment Fluency in object-oriented programming/design Academic, professional or internship experience in one of Java, Python, Javascript, HTML, SQL or C++ Even Better If... Experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools Ability to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes Experience using Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini or other agent-based frameworks Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Team-player with the ability to work effectively and efficiently with others Be a self-starter and possess strong sense of self-motivation Experience using telemetry and metrics to drive operational excellence Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role​: We are seeking a Back-End engineer to be part of our Identity product group. In this role, you will be part of the cloud product software engineering team, responsible for developing new features and working closely with other teams such as UI and Sensor. This is a hybrid role and will requires the ability to work 2 days per week from our office in Sunnyvale CA. What You'll Do: The right candidate will possess proven software engineering skills, with experience building and launching large, distributed systems in a team-centric environment. You will work and contribute to a dynamic, entrepreneurial setting and will mentor junior engineers. In this role, you must be comfortable managing competing priorities and be able to bring order to ambiguous scenarios. Maturity, impeccable judgment, and the ability to influence and lead are essential to success in this role. Candidates must be data-driven and analytical. You will be required to clearly & effectively communicate (written as well as verbally) across the organization and up to senior leadership. Our team members must have a growth mindset. CrowdStrike::workday::R30387.raw_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: As our new software engineer in CrowdStrike, you’ll contribute to the LogScale application for observability, log management, and security events. As a member of the new US based engine team you will focus on the LogScale engine that makes LogScale scale by developing new features as well as improving existing functionality. This is a highly distributed system that ingests Petabytes of data per day through both our SaaS and On Premise offerings. You will be joining a distributed team of highly collaborative engineers who share a strong passion for the product. In this role you will get a chance to work on hard engineering problems that do not have well-defined solutions. You will become one of the go-to experts of the LogScale engine, and will have a broad understanding of the entire LogScale architecture. Teams in LogScale have a great amount of autonomy, and own a part of the LogScale experience, from ideation and development to deployment and feedback. This includes ensuring high quality of the features they deliver, by writing automated tests, and performing manual tests. Moreover, we do not just throw over features to our operations teams, but we constantly observe and monitor new features in production, with LogScale dashboards of course. An important part of our work is making sure that LogScale continues to be scalable in terms of efficiently ingesting and digesting events, querying for the right data, while also ensuring the stability of the clusters. Some of the critical elements that the team is working on improving is the query execution engine that makes the LogScale queries be lightning fast. The team is also working with our internal “global” data storage using Kafka and the storage engine that ensures data is stored in the right number of replicas as well as on the correct nodes and in bucket storage such as S3. You will be playing a crucial role in ensuring that LogScale can continue with its successful durability and high availability. This role is hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week on-site at one of the posted locations. What You'll Do: Work in a team of friendly, trustworthy and knowledgeable colleagues Work on cross-team platform-level initiatives and projects Participate in scoping, designing and developing of new features and lead delivery of solutions to open-ended problems Contribute to moving the scalability of our LogScale engine to the next level Develop the LogScale backend in Scala and extending our engine to keep LogScale scale with increasing ingest load while ensuring high availability Communicate technical decisions through design documents, technical talks and improving our internal documentation. Provide technical advice on decisions, and research and propose new technologies Lead delivery of new solutions within the team and mentor team members through code reviews, pairing, documentation, design reviews and technical guidance Monitor and followup on features released to customers on-prem and on cloud Troubleshoot critical production issues both on our own Software as a Service customers and our on-premise customers What You'll Need: Must be a U.S. Citizen or US Permanent Resident. A passion for or personal interest in distributed systems and curiosity of how our running systems are doing Experience in software development in general and the ability to juggle making pragmatic tradeoffs between short-time delivery needs vs long-term product goals Experience in contributing to broad technical leadership in products or services Fluency in both functional and object oriented programming and the ability to pick up new languages on the go A can-do attitude, and that you thrive collaborating in a team and are not afraid of taking on responsibilities Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points: Experience programming in Scala Experience with commercial clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) Experience with Kafka Hands on experience in large-scale (distributed) system architecture, high scalability and availability, and optimization #LI-SS1 This role will require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass additional background and fingerprint check(s) consistent with government customer requirements.
